evidence.observation: Growth held at ~750 °C on setpoint; cooldown decaying smoothly from 722 to 573 °C with heater at 0%
Flow tracks setpoints (99-100 sccm growth, 200 sccm cooldown)
Pressure stable ~3.0-3.3 Torr in growth, ~4.1 Torr at higher cooldown flow
Exhaust O2 low (3-6 ppm), no leak signature

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (e.g., Raman/optical/AFM) of the sample to determine whether the target film grew.
